fields.what_it_is: ArtiFascia® is an absorbable dural repair graft for the repair of cranial dural defects. ArtiFascia® is a highly flexible, easy to handle, non-friable soft matrix composed of synthetic non-woven fibers and a non-porous film. ArtiFascia® readily conforms to the surface of the wound area and is applied to the dural defect by using sutures.
